questions.question: If '–' stands for '×', '×' stands for '+', '+' stands for'÷' and '÷' stands for '–', then what will be the value of 516 – 2558 + 172 × 12 ÷ 7086?
questions.solution:
Given equation: 516 – 2558 + 172 × 12 ÷ 7086

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a45b5b9191c13cd4da310eb8df100becb078c240f4b0e763420ec154fb42a5fd.png] 

Decoding the given information :

 
 

 Symbol
 -
 ×
 +
 ÷
 
 

 Means
 ×
 +
 ÷
 -
 
 

Now, replacing the sign from left to right and using BODMAS rule, we get :

New equation : 516 × 2558 ÷ 172 + 12 - 7086

Calculation :

⇒ __**516 ×**____** 2558 **____**÷**____** 172 **__+ 12 - 7086

⇒ __**7674**____** + 12**__ - 7086

⇒ **__7686 __**__**- 7086**__

⇒ 600.

Hence, the correct answer is "600".

questions.question:
By interchanging the given two signs and two numbers (not digits), which of the following equations will be correct? ÷ and ×, 25 and 12

I. 105 ÷ 10 × 75 + 25 – 12 = 3

II. 75 × 12 ÷ 25 + 14 – 10 = 40

options.text: Both I and II are correct.
Neither I nor II is correct.

questions.solution:
BODMAS Table: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d50192f098c21078501d30eeafe1a8c64bc30dd9621c48caa8a39ffc60f68b64.png] 

Given equation I: 105 ÷ 10 × 75 + 25 – 12 = 3

Now, if ÷ and ×, 25 and 12 are interchanged, then:

⇒ 105 × __**10 ÷ 75**__ + 12 – 25 = 3

⇒ __**105 × 0.133**__ + 12 – 25 = 3

⇒ __**13.965 + 12**__ – 25 = 3

⇒ __**25.965 – **____**25**__ = 3

= 0.965 ≠ 3.

LHS ≠ RHS.

Given equation II: 75 × 12 ÷ 25 + 14 – 10 = 40

Now, if ÷ and ×, 25 and 12 are interchanged, then:

⇒ __**75 ÷ 25**__ × 12 + 14 – 10 = 40

⇒ __**3 × 12**__ + 14 – 10 = 40

⇒ __**36**____** + 14**__ – 10 = 40

⇒ __**50**____** – 10**__ = 40

= 40 = 40

LHS = RHS.

Here, Only II are correct equation after interchanging the given symbol and number.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All radios are electronic items.

Some speakers are electronic items.

**Conclusions:**

I. No radio is a speaker.

II. Some radios are speakers.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow.
Either conclusion I or II follows.

questions.solution:
Statement:

All radios are electronic items.

Some speakers are electronic items.

The least possible diagram for the given statements is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ffb1f8306e47c4dc2144f6cee6acdc0ab5fcb2295500cb2c39c3ae80d717dea3.png] 

Conclusions:

(i) No radio is a speaker - False (Because No definite relation given between Radio and Speaker, so it can be possible only).

(ii) Some radios are speakers - False (Because No definite relation given between Radio and Speaker, so it can be possible only).

Here, Both the conclusions are wrong, but it forms the complementary pair for Either-or.

So, Either conclusion I or II follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 Complementary pairs for Either or case are:-

1) Some + No

2) All + Some not

Rules for Either or Case:-

1. Subject and Predicate of the element should be same.

2. Two of the conclusions should be can’t be determined.

3. Both should form a complementary pair.

questions.question: Six people, F, G, H, I, J and K, got different marks in their examination. G got more marks than F and K. F got more marks than I, but not the highest marks. G scored more marks than H. K got more marks than J, but fewer marks than H. I got the thirdlowest marks. F got more marks than K but less than H. F got 59 marks and K got 46 marks. Who among the following got the highest marks?
questions.solution:
Given: Six people, F, G, H, I, J and K. 

1)I got the third lowest marks. 

__ > __ > __ > I > __ > __

G got more marks than F and K. 

F got more marks than I, but not the highest marks. 

F got more marks than K but less than H.

G scored more marks than H. 

G > H > F > I > K > __

K got more marks than J, but fewer marks than H. 

G > H > F > I > K > J

F got 59 marks and K got 46 marks. 

G > H > F(59) > I > K(46) > J

Here, G got the highest marks.

Hence, the correct answer is **"G"**.
